content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD sponge-layer routines (BSD header L12-L55): six external subroutines. (1) SPONGE_DAMPING (L63-L77, 'Larsen-Dancy(1983) type sponge layer' @L57-L58, 10/27/2010 Shi): over the whole local grid divides ETA (only where MASK>ZERO, L69-L71), U and V (unconditionally, L72-L73) by SPONGE(I,J). (2) ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC (L88-L167, 'Larsen-Dancy(1983) type wave-maker' @L81-L82, 05/01/2014): with Salatin et al. 2021 optimization (citation L113-L117) precomputes BB/CC=COS/SIN(pi/2.0_SP+Segma_Ser(KK_sponge)*TIME) per frequency (L126-L127; the Phase_Ser-including versions are commented @L124-L125); sums incident wave fields Ein2D/Uin2D/Vin2D from Cm_eta/Sm_eta, Cm_u/Sm_u, Cm_v/Sm_v (L135-L140); if TIDAL_BC_GEN_ABS adds TideWEST_ETA/U/V (L143-L147); relaxes only Eta toward Ein2D via Eta=Ein2D+(Eta-Ein2D)*SPONGE_TIDE_WEST(I,J) @L151 (SpongeMaker-based version commented @L149; U/V relaxation commented @L153-L154); recomputes fluxes HU/HV=(Depth+ETA)*U/V (L156-L157); saves tmp4preview=Ein2D @L165. (3) CALCULATE_SPONGE_MAKER(M,N,Nghost,DX,DY,Sponge_west_width,R_sponge,A_sponge,SPONGE) (L176-L210): west-side wavemaker sponge — Iwidth=INT(Sponge_west_width/DX)+Nghost @L194; for I=1..Iwidth keeps lim=existing SPONGE>1 else 1 (L197-L201), ri=R_Sponge**(50*(i+(iista-1)-1)/(Iwidth-1)) @L204 (ykchoi Jan/23/2018 iista replacing npx*Mglob/px @L203), Sponge=MAX(A_Sponge**ri,lim) @L206. (4) CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE(...CDsponge from GLOBAL) (L220-L349): friction-type sponge — for each active side computes tmp_2d_1/tmp_2d_2 = MAX(CDsponge*TANH(ri/10.0),lim) with linear index ramps ri=MAX(0.0,REAL(Iwidth-i-(iista-1))) west @L263, east variant with (px-npx-1)*(iiend-iista+1) @L280, south @L310, north @L331; SPONGE=max of the pair after west/east (L287-L295) and again after south/north (L338-L346); note @L244-L245 'I used SPONGE represent CD from input, do not mess up with the sponge defined in the direction sponge'. (5) CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE (L359-L491): identical structure with coefficient Csp (tmp=MAX(Csp*TANH(ri/10.0),lim) @L404/L425/L455/L476). (6) CALCULATE_SPONGE (L502-L635, 10/27/2010): the direct Larsen-Dancy sponge divisor field for all four sides — lim floors at existing SPONGE>1 else 1; ri=R_Sponge**(50*(i+(iista-1)-1)/(Iwidth-1)) west @L545, east @L565, south @L596, north @L617; per-pair max combine (L572-L581, L624-L633) with reset IF(Sponge<A_Sponge**(R_Sponge**50))Sponge=1.0_SP @L579/@L631. (7) CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER (L646-L787, 04/27/2017): rank 0 builds a global drag map tmp_glob(Mglob+2*Nghost,Nglob+2*Nghost) — for every cell with BreakWaterWidth>0, within the index radius Iwidth/Jwidth=INT(Width/DXg or DYg) (L686-L687; loop bounds fixed per comment @L688 'fixed bug from gangfeng 02/26/2021, should add 2*Nghost' L689-L690) sets tmp_2d=BreakWaterAbsorbCoef*TANH((BreakWaterWidth-ri)/(0.3_SP*BreakWaterWidth)) for ri=SQRT(((Ib-I)*DXg)**2+((Jb-J)*DYg)**2)<=Width, keeping the max @L699; then distributes to each rank's CD_breakwater via ghost-shifted index MPI_Gathers (L731-L746), rank-0 self-copy CD_breakwater=tmp_glob(1:Mloc,1:Nloc) @L749, and per-rank mpi_isend of ghost-inclusive blocks / mpi_irecv into CD_breakwater (L752-L779; old MPI_Scatter loop commented L713-L729).

verbatim_spans.text: !    SPONGE_DAMPING is subroutine for dampping waves using Larsen-Dancy(1983)
! note that I used SPONGE represent CD from input, do not mess up
! fixed bug from gangfeng 02/26/2021, should add 2*Nghost

unresolved: ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC relaxes only Eta @L151 — the U/V relaxation lines are commented out (L153-L154) while HU/HV are rebuilt from the un-relaxed U,V @L156-L157; also the relaxation runs over the entire local grid (L132-L133) using SPONGE_TIDE_WEST from TIDE_MODULE (west array only, no east/south/north counterpart here)

BB/CC drop Phase_Ser (commented @L124-L125 vs active @L126-L127) — random/imported phases are not applied in this optimized path; whether Phase_LEFT/Phase_Ser entered Cm/Sm upstream is outside this file
SPONGE_DAMPING divides U,V by SPONGE even where MASK==0 (only ETA is mask-guarded, L69-L73)

Larsen-Dancy exponents use integer arithmetic 50*(...)/(Iwidth-1) (L204, L545, L565, L596, L617) — quantized steps and no Iwidth=1 guard; friction/diffusion ramps divide ri by 10.0 cells regardless of sponge width (L265 etc.)

CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE declares SPONGE INTENT(OUT) @L237 and zeroes it @L250, but CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE/CALCULATE_SPONGE use INTENT(INOUT) (L376, L520) preserving prior content via lim — the three routines write the same-named argument with different accumulation conventions (note @L244-L245)

CALCULATE_SPONGE reset floor A_Sponge**(R_Sponge**50) (L579, L631): R_Sponge**50 is a REAL exponentiation here while the ramp exponents are integer-quantized — the cutoff value's consistency with the ramp is implicit

CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER: east/north ramp offsets use (px-npx-1)*(iiend-iista+1) (L280/L331/L423/L474/L565/L617) which assumes equal block widths across ranks; Din2D @L99, xx @L240/@L379/@L523, DXg/DYg locals (L247-248 etc.), Stokes_Drift_Ser/Grav imports, R_sponge/A_sponge dummies in friction/diffusion versions are declared/imported but unused in their routines

tmp_glob is allocated on all ranks @L671 (only rank 0 fills it) and deallocated @L785; receiving ranks' CD_breakwater is filled by mpi_irecv @L775 relying on Mloc==Niend-Nista+1+2*Nghost shape match — unchecked in this file
